# Project rules

- Always use pnpm for dependencies.
- Never run `git push` without asking.
- Do not edit `legacy/` files.
- Before each commit, run `pnpm test`.
- API code lives in `src/api/`.
- Check style with `pnpm run lint`.
- Format with `pnpm run format`.
- Keep functions small and readable.

```sh
npm install   # code blocks are ignored
```
